messages:
Maya (CS): quick weekly pulse for Lumenix — noticing model-mix shift since fastlane-v2 rollout, can we get a short readout?
Ravi (Eng): grabbing metrics now, will drop numbers in a minute.
deploy-bot: deployment fastlane-v2 -> prod at 2025-10-14T09:45:02Z :white_check_mark:
Ravi (Eng): ok 7-day comparison vs prior week:
Ravi (Eng): - total requests +9% w/w
Ravi (Eng): - fastlane-v2 routed = 26% (we targeted 25%)
Ravi (Eng): - automatic fallbacks to baseline = 4.6% (baseline week 0.7%)
Ravi (Eng): - median latency +18ms, p95 jumped from 410ms -> 610ms
Ravi (Eng): - 5xx rate peaked at 2.3% on Tue 14:00, mostly timeouts/retries; overall week avg 0.9%
Ravi (Eng): - spend for Lumenix +15% due to retries and longer p95 token usage
Zoe (Solutions): Lumenix raised a support ticket — summaries truncated on ~10% of long reports, shared samples in ticket CS-5021
Leah (Acct Owner): heads up: renewal call in 3 weeks; if we see persistent quality regressions risk moves to high.
Maya (CS): are fallbacks capacity-related or timing/latency? Ravi any log markers?
Ravi (Eng): tail logs label most as `fallback_reason=latency_tail`; tiny fraction `model_oom`. Example log: `2025-10-16T11:23:44Z WARN req=0xabc fallback_reason=latency_tail route=fastlane-v2 p95=624ms`
Mika (SRE): we observed increased kernel stalls on seq>800 with the new attention kernel on the node class used by Lumenix; feeding that into perf triage.
Jonas (Prod): immediate mitigations: 1) reduce traffic to fastlane-v2 to 10% for Lumenix only, 2) enable prefix KV warmup for top prompt templates, 3) short-term increase baseline headroom so fallback cost less.
Jonas (Prod): proposed canary policy snippet:
Jonas (Prod): ```
route: lumenix
weights:
  fastlane-v2: 0.10
  baseline-stable: 0.90
fallback_threshold: 0.04
monitor: p95,errors,fallback_rate
```
Maya (CS): action list:
Maya (CS): - @Ravi: apply per-customer gate for Lumenix -> lower to 10% (ETA 20m)
Maya (CS): - @Jonas: deploy KV warmup rule for their top 8 prompts (ETA 36h)
Maya (CS): - @Zoe: gather 15 representative inputs from the ticket for evals (ETA EOD)
Maya (CS): - @Mika: run kernel-level perf job for seq lengths 512/768/1024 and share heatmap (ETA 24h)
Maya (CS): - I'll update the renewal tracker to "monitor" and prep talking points for the call.
Ravi (Eng): made the routing change: route weight set to 10% for account=lumenix (change id r-4410)
deploy-bot: routing change r-4410 applied at 2025-10-16T12:05:10Z
Jonas (Prod): starting synthetic perf run on fastlane-v2 with seq=1024 now, will post logs + p95 breakdown
Zoe (Solutions): pinged Lumenix PM, scheduled a triage with them tomorrow 10:00 PT to review examples and interim controls
Leah (Acct Owner): please include me on the triage, I'll prep the renewal note after the sync.
Mika (SRE): initial perf run shows p95 tail reduces ~140ms when switching to alternate kernel flags; need controlled rollout to avoid regressions on other tenants.
Ravi (Eng): follow-up: most fallbacks clustered to a subset of shards; working hypothesis: kernel selection + seq length distribution mismatch.
Maya (CS): good progress — keep updates in this thread, I'll fold a short summary into next Monday's account health. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
